thread:
alex: Heads up — main CI is red on nightly: several tests failing with an 'alloc spike' / OOM pattern since this morning. Last green build was at 1758199800. @maria @jamie can you help bisect? Job: https://ci.redwood.ai/builds/5412 :thinking_face:

jamie: I'm rerunning the flaky job now.

ci-bot: Rerun started: build 5412.rebuild.1 (triggered by jamie)

alex: Failing tests: tests/inference/test_allocator.py::test_pool_growth and a couple e2e jobs. Logs show: "Allocation spike: 2.4x" in allocator::grow().

sre-bot: Perf alert — allocation rate spike detected at 2026-03-17T03:12Z (2.4x). Correlated with builds >= 1758200000.

maria: Do we have the last known-good commit hash? I can start a git bisect if someone points me to it.

alex: last green commit: abc123def (1758199800). Failures begin at merge around def456789 (PR #4310) but unclear if that's the culprit.

maria: Ok I'll try a local bisect. Can someone paste a minimal repro command for the failing test in CI?

jamie: Repro snippet we used in CI: 
```
docker run --rm -v $(pwd):/app redwood/inference-ci:latest \
  pytest tests/inference/test_allocator.py::test_pool_growth -q
```

maria: Running bisect now: 
```
git fetch origin
git bisect start def456789 abc123def
git bisect run pytest -q tests/inference/test_allocator.py::test_pool_growth
```

maria: Narrowed it down to commit def789abc — the change touches mempool sizing and removed a safety cap (PR 4309).

alex: That was a perf tweak from the optimizer team. If removing the cap spikes allocations, we should revert until we design a safer change.

jamie: I opened an emergency revert PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/repo/pull/4321 — reintroduces the cap. :thumbsup:

maria: Kicking off CI against the revert branch to confirm.

ci-bot: Build queued: 5420 (revert branch)

jamie: If the revert branch is green, let's merge and follow up with a measured perf pass. Pinged @eng-oncall for merge approval.

alex: Sounds good — once merged I'll coordinate release notes and notify product. Also we should add an eval to catch allocation regressions. :eyes:

maria: Revert build 5420 is green — all tests passed.

jamie: Revert merged. Notifying perf/ops.

alex: Great work, thanks everyone. Let's add a CI check for allocation regression telemetry so we don't regress silently.

sre-bot: Incident ticket created: INC-2026 — allocation-regression-investigation.
